name: Linden House Hotel
greeting: Good afternoon, Linden House Hotel. I'm the AI assistant, and this is a demo line. How may I help?
summary: An 18-room country-house hotel near Southwell with a small spa, a restaurant, and gardens.
address: Linden House, Halam Road, Southwell NG25 0AZ
core_facts: Rooms from £129 a night including breakfast, subject to availability; room bookings are made by the reservations team.
The spa is open to hotel guests and day visitors, 9am to 7pm every day.
Free parking for 30 cars. Electric car charging available.
Dogs welcome in two garden rooms, £20 a night.

policies.spa_cancellation: Spa treatments can be moved or cancelled free with 24 hours' notice.
policies.rooms: Room bookings, changes and prices are handled by the reservations team, not by phone with the assistant: take the caller's name, number, dates and number of guests for a call back.

knowledge.q: What time is check-in and check-out?
knowledge.a: Check-in is from 3pm and check-out by 11am. Late check-out until 1pm is £25, subject to availability.
Rooms start at £129 a night including breakfast for two, rising at weekends and in summer. The reservations team will confirm the exact price for the dates.
Yes, full English or continental breakfast is included, served 7 till 10, 8 till 10:30 at weekends.
Free parking for 30 cars, with two electric car chargers.
Dogs are welcome in our two garden rooms at £20 a night, and in the bar. Not in the restaurant or spa.
Yes, day visitors are welcome for treatments. The pool and sauna are for hotel guests and treatment customers.
Yes, weddings for up to 80 in the garden room. The events team handles them, so take the caller's details for a call back.

knowledge.q: Is the restaurant open to non-residents?
knowledge.a: Yes, dinner is served 6 till 9 every evening, and non-residents are welcome.
Two ground-floor rooms are fully accessible with wet rooms. The spa is on the ground floor.
